how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-sort:paladin-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:1642:details:0: In all things, a paladin must reflect the Light which supplements our strength. To strive to be divine for one of our kind does not mean we strive for godhood--we strive to be good in all actions.
rows.quest:1642:details:1: BAlthough called upon to smite evil in these harsh times, you must always remember that it's aiding others that will truly set you apart from the citizens of ⟦E2⟧. Compassion, patience, bravery--these things mean as much to a paladin as strength in battle.
rows.quest:1642:details:2: BKnow this well, and never forget it.
rows.quest:1642:completion:0: Hello again, ⟦1⟧. How goes your studies of the Tome of Divinity?
rows.quest:1642:completion:1: BThen you should be prepared to have yourself tested. There are always tasks to be done throughout the city and our lands; acts of compassion and understanding; people who need help; creatures to slay.
rows.quest:1642:completion:2: BBy proving you have the patience to help others, especially those who are less fortunate, you prove that you are a servant of the Light and of sound mind.
rows.quest:1643:obj:0: Search the Trade District of ⟦E1⟧ for Stephanie Turner.
rows.quest:1643:details:0: Your task then, ⟦2⟧, is to find someone here in ⟦E1⟧ that is in need of aid. Someone who is pure of heart and motive. Perhaps someone helping others. Perhaps someone in need of a guide. Regardless, the person must have noble intent and be relying on your kindness.
rows.quest:1643:details:1: BDo this, and return to me when you are finished. Then, we shall discuss more of your path and what it means to be a paladin of the Light.
rows.quest:1643:completion:0: Oh, hello, luv. How go your adventures? Oh, I'm so glad to hear you're doing well.
rows.quest:1643:completion:1: BOh, me? Thank you for asking--I'm doing well, all things considered.
rows.quest:1643:completion:2: BThe increase in tradesmen has kind of put a damper on the amount of leather and cloth people are willing to part with these days, so it's been tougher to make clothing for the children at the orphanage, but we'll manage. By "we" I mean my husband and I. He's up in ⟦E3⟧ trying to seek help from the citizens there.
rows.quest:1644:obj:0: Bring 10 Linen Cloth to Stephanie Turner in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:1644:details:0: Bless their hearts, most of them have no families because of the Scourge attacks in the last decade.
rows.quest:1644:details:1: BMy husband John collects the materials for me to make the shirts and pants for the children, but I haven't even had time to do that. I've been too focused on keeping food on their plates, and a roof over their heads.
rows.quest:1644:details:2: BWhat's that? You'd be willing to help? Oh, thank the Light, and thank you, ⟦3⟧.
rows.quest:1644:details:3: BIf you could bring me some ⟦E4⟧ cloth so I can sew clothes for the kids, that would help me out so much.
rows.quest:1644:completion:0: Thank you, ⟦4⟧, thank you so much!
rows.quest:1644:completion:1: BThe children will be so pleased, and you've saved me so much time. I'll now be able to focus on the children's other needs, and hopefully my John will be able to return home sooner than we thought.
rows.quest:1644:completion:2: BThank you again, ⟦5⟧. I knew I could rely on the charity of others. The Light be with you.
rows.quest:1646:details:0: In all things, a paladin must reflect the Light which supplements our strength. To strive to be divine for one of our kind does not mean we strive for godhood--we strive to be good in all actions.
rows.quest:1646:details:1: BAlthough called upon to smite evil in these harsh times, you must always remember that it's aiding others that will truly set you apart from the citizens of ⟦E2⟧. Compassion, patience, bravery--these things mean as much to a paladin as strength in battle.
rows.quest:1646:details:2: BKnow this well, and never forget it.
rows.quest:1646:completion:0: Welcome back, ⟦6⟧. You've spent time reading the book, I hope?
rows.quest:1646:completion:1: BThen you should be prepared to have yourself tested. There are always tasks to be done throughout the city and our lands; acts of compassion and understanding; people who need help; creatures to slay.
rows.quest:1646:completion:2: BBy proving you have the patience to help others, especially those who are less fortunate, you prove that you are a servant of the Light and of sound mind.
rows.quest:1647:obj:0: Search the outer ring of ⟦E3⟧ for John Turner.
rows.quest:1647:details:0: Your task then, ⟦7⟧, is to find someone here in ⟦E3⟧ that is in need of aid. Someone who is pure of heart and motive. Perhaps someone helping others. Perhaps someone in need of a guide. Regardless, the person must have noble intent and be relying on your kindness.
rows.quest:1647:details:1: BDo this, and return to me when you are finished. Then, we shall discuss more of your path and what it means to be a paladin of the Light. I will remain here in the temple for your return. Other paladins will need my guidance also.
rows.quest:1647:completion:0: THE ORPHANAGE OF STOR... oh, sorry, didn't mean to shout at you, sir.
rows.quest:1647:completion:1: BMy name is John Turner. How are you?
rows.quest:1647:completion:2: BGood, good, glad to hear things go well for you. I've had a long day of work already, and I miss my wife terribly, but that's the price you have to pay when there are mouths to feed and backs to clothe.
rows.quest:1648:obj:0: Bring 10 Linen Cloth to John Turner in ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:1648:details:0: My wife and I run an orphanage in ⟦E1⟧, mostly for children who have lost parents due to the attacks by the Scourge in the last decade. I come to ⟦E3⟧ every month or so to see about collecting more supplies from the citizens here, and talk to the various groups to see if they can do anything to help.
rows.quest:1648:details:1: BThis trip's been agonizingly slow, and not very productive.
rows.quest:1648:details:2: BIf I could just get some more ⟦E4⟧ for my wife to make some clothes, I could finally send a shipment home.
rows.quest:1648:completion:0: This is so wonderful of you, ⟦8⟧. Thank you again.
rows.quest:1648:completion:1: BYou're a noble man for doing this for me. It's no wonder you've chosen to follow the Light. I wish there was some way I could repay you for all you've done... what's that? It's the least you could do? See? That's what I'm talking about, ⟦9⟧, noble to the end.
rows.quest:1648:completion:2: BBe safe, and may the Light protect you in your travels.
rows.quest:1649:details:0: Valor, and all the virtues that go along with it, are like rare minerals: you must cherish them when you find them because of their value, but you must also take time to harvest them... refine them. When mixed together properly, a strong alloy is formed, sometimes unbreakable by even the most powerful blows.
rows.quest:1649:details:1: BThis strength, your faith, your bravery, must be tested. You must learn to never lose faith and realize that with the power of the Light, you can overcome things that most others cannot.
rows.quest:1649:completion:0: Ah, you wish to petition me for a test of valor. Splendid.
rows.quest:1649:completion:1: BThere are many tasks throughout the city and surrounding lands that hold much challenge, and they could use a ⟦10⟧ with your skills.
rows.quest:1649:completion:2: BThis test should not be taken lightly, ⟦11⟧. This, like many things along our path, could take our lives. The Church always wishes to bolster its ranks, but it understands the sacrifices needed to ensure the paladins serving it are worthy.
rows.quest:1650:details:0: Good! Your lack of hesitation is a sure sign that you are prepared and eager to test yourself. So be it.
rows.quest:1650:details:1: BAt the very ends of ⟦E5⟧'s Longshore, a small house overlooks the ocean. There, a couple lives, the Stilwells. Jordan is an incredible smith, and he's gone to ⟦E3⟧ to meet with the dwarves for a while. But this has left Daphne, his wife, alone and unprotected.
rows.quest:1650:details:2: BReports suggest that the Defias have all but taken over the area, Daphne may need some protection from the villains. Go there.
rows.quest:1650:completion:0: Hello, ⟦12⟧. I'm assuming by all that armor and weapon of yours, you're either here to try and take my land, or the Church finally sent someone to help protect me while my Jordan's gone.
rows.quest:1650:completion:1: B Well, let me introduce myself: I'm Daphne Stilwell. It's a pleasure.
rows.quest:1650:completion:2: BNow, you're not too late... I've only killed a half dozen of the scum since last sun up. They've been a little slow getting 'round the bend up there, but they probably saw you coming, which means they'll probably be here any minute.
rows.quest:1651:obj:0: Defend Daphne Stilwell from the Defias attack.
rows.quest:1651:obj:1: BNeither of your spirits must be released from their mortal coils if you wish to succeed.
rows.quest:1651:obj:2: BAfter you are successful, speak to Daphne Stilwell again.
rows.quest:1651:details:0: Now, they'll be coming again soon, I'd wager, so get yourself ready.
rows.quest:1651:details:1: BI've got myself a gun in the house. I'll grab it and be ready to help you out, but for the most part, you're on your own.
rows.quest:1651:details:2: BI've no idea how many they'll send, but I'm sure it'll be more than the few they sent earlier.
rows.quest:1651:details:3: BAsk the Light for whatever blessings you can because... did you hear that? I think they're coming.
rows.quest:1651:details:4: BWe make our stand near the house!
rows.quest:1651:completion:0: We've done it, ⟦13⟧! Thank you for your help. You were truly amazing out there. I never thought a ⟦14⟧ could handle so many enemies at once.
rows.quest:1651:completion:1: BYou've truly shown bravery in the face of overwhelming odds.
rows.quest:1652:details:0: Please, return to Duthorian and let him know that I'm safe for now. I have you and the Church to thank for that.
rows.quest:1652:details:1: BHe'll send word to ⟦E3⟧ to let my Jordan know that he has nothing to fear.
rows.quest:1652:details:2: BOh, how I miss my husband. I can't wait till he returns.
rows.quest:1652:completion:0: So, we meet again, ⟦15⟧, and you are in high spirits, I see.
rows.quest:1652:completion:1: BThe Stilwell home will be safe for another day, and from your story I see that there was no shortage of danger to be found. Well done.
rows.quest:1652:completion:2: BDaphne and Jordan have helped the Church greatly, and having you protect their property--and their very lives--was the least we could do for them.
rows.quest:1652:completion:3: BFor your valor, you will be rewarded.
rows.quest:1653:details:0: Actually, I have no doubt that Jordan himself would like to thank you, and seeing as I need a messenger to send word that his wife is safe, I think you'd be a perfect choice.
rows.quest:1653:details:1: BJordan was to be a paladin of the Light before his dedication to his father's craft took him on another path--he's intimately familiar with our way of life and is considered among our most faithful.
rows.quest:1653:details:2: BHe should still be in ⟦E3⟧--he likes to work outside the gates during the day, something about the cool mountain air.
rows.quest:1653:completion:0: Good day, ⟦16⟧. The Light is with you, I trust?
rows.quest:1653:completion:1: BWhat's that? You were sent by Duthorian!? My wife, how is she? I knew there was going to be trouble if I left.
rows.quest:1653:completion:2: BPlease tell me she's... oh, thank goodness. I'm so glad that she's safe. The Defias were a threat long before these attacks, but now the King's advisors cannot deny it.
rows.quest:1653:completion:3: BWhat else did Duthorian have to say? You're the one that was sent to protect my wife? Then I thank you again, ⟦17⟧. I couldn't think of a better test of valor than that.
rows.quest:1654:obj:0: Using Jordan's Weapon Notes, find some Whitestone Oak Lumber, Bailor's Refined Ore Shipment, Jordan's Smithing ⟦E6⟧, and a Kor Gem, and return them to Jordan Stilwell in ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:1654:details:0: I'd like to reward you if you'd be willing to accept such a thing? Don't misunderstand me, my generosity is dependent on how much help you can be, but I see us both benefiting greatly from such an alliance.
rows.quest:1654:details:1: BI will craft for you a weapon worthy of what you've accomplished, a symbol of paladinhood and the Light, but you must gather the items I need to craft it. I've already started taking notes on the items, it just requires someone brave and skilled enough to recover them. What do you say, ⟦18⟧?
rows.quest:1654:completion:0: This is wonderful! You've gotten all the items.
rows.quest:1654:completion:1: BI should have no problem forging you a grand weapon with these. I've actually had the plans for doing this for some time. I just never had the opportunity to gather the goods. Thank you, ⟦19⟧.
rows.quest:1654:completion:2: BIt feels good to have my father's hammer again...and a Kor gem. I never thought I'd see one of these myself.
rows.quest:1661:details:0: I greet you once again, ⟦20⟧. I am more proud to call you ⟦21⟧ than ever before--your dedication is a tribute to us all.
rows.quest:1661:details:1: BThe time has come for me to bestow a great gift upon you. But know this, for now I give you this freely, but later, when time permits, this will be a much greater challenge to all paladins who choose to undertake my quest.
rows.quest:1661:details:2: BSpeak to me again and I shall grant you a great boon.
rows.quest:1778:details:0: I'm going to see about making plans to return home soon. Hopefully, Stephanie is doing well back in ⟦E1⟧. I can't wait to see her again. Till next we meet, ⟦22⟧.
rows.quest:1778:completion:0: So, you've returned so quickly, huh? And what pray tell have you accomplished in your time away from here?
rows.quest:1778:completion:1: BWere you able to help a noble cause? Perhaps you've learned the value of charity or some more about your obligations to the citizens of ⟦E2⟧. Tell me, who have you helped and how.... Impressive, ⟦23⟧, those are surely the actions of one who follows the Light.
rows.quest:1778:completion:2: BSuch sacrifice will always be rewarded in time.
rows.quest:1779:obj:0: Take the Symbol of Life and speak to Muiredon Battleforge in ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:1779:details:0: I want you to take this, ⟦24⟧. It is called the Symbol of Life.
rows.quest:1779:details:1: BYou've proven charitable and patient, and now I want you to prove just how adept you've become in both combat, and power.
rows.quest:1779:details:2: BMy husband Muiredon returned recently from an encounter with some Dark Iron dwarves, and he barely escaped with his life--he's over there having his wounds healed by one of our priests.
rows.quest:1779:details:3: BTake the Symbol and speak to him. If you can help him, then we will speak again soon. May the Light shine upon you.
rows.quest:1779:completion:1: BGood day to ya, ⟦25⟧. Don't mind me wounds, the good priest 'ere'll take care of ol' Muiredon in time. Not needin' the power of that Symbol of Life ya got there quite yet.
rows.quest:1779:completion:2: BSo, me wife sent ya o'er to speak to me, huh? Fair 'nough. I'll take the time to talk to ya-I'll tell ya exactly wut happened to Muiredon and his best friend Narm, a ⟦26⟧ jus' like yerself.
rows.quest:1780:details:0: I'll take these to the children this very day. Please be safe, good ⟦27⟧. It is not often ⟦28⟧ of your character show their faces in the city, but you've proven that the paladins here in ⟦E1⟧ shall never turn their backs on those in need.
rows.quest:1780:completion:0: You've returned so quickly, ⟦29⟧. And what have you accomplished in your time away from the Cathedral?
rows.quest:1780:completion:1: BHave you helped a noble cause? Perhaps you've learned the value of charity or some more about your obligations to the citizens of ⟦E2⟧. Tell me, who have you helped and how... Well, I'm impressed, ⟦30⟧, those are surely the actions of one who follows the Light and values others above oneself.
rows.quest:1780:completion:2: BSuch sacrifice will always be rewarded in time.
rows.quest:1781:obj:0: Take the Symbol of Life to Gazin Tenorm in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:1781:details:0: Take this, ⟦31⟧. It is called the Symbol of Life.
rows.quest:1781:details:1: BYou've proven charitable and patient, and now the time has come to see if you're powerful enough to focus one of the Light's greatest gifts.
rows.quest:1781:details:2: BMy friend Gazin returned recently from an encounter with some Defias in Elwynn near Heroes' Vigil--he barely escaped with his life. He's near the altar having his wounds healed by our priests.
rows.quest:1781:details:3: BTake the Symbol and speak to him. If you can help him, then we will speak again soon. May you bask in the Light's glory.
rows.quest:1781:completion:1: BPleasure to meet you, ⟦32⟧. Don't mind my wounds, the good priest here can take care of ol' Gazin this time. I won't be needing the power of that Symbol of Life you've got there... not yet anyway.
rows.quest:1781:completion:2: BSo, Duthorian sent you to speak to me, huh? Fair enough. I'll tell you exactly what befell me and my friend Henze. And with any luck, and some skill on your part, perhaps you can still help us all.
rows.quest:1783:obj:0: Take the Symbol of Life and ⟦E7⟧ Narm Faulk in ⟦E8⟧.
rows.quest:1783:details:0: We was spyin' on some of the Dark Iron dwarves that've bunkered down south of Helm's Bed Lake. We knew they was up to no good, so Narm an' me thought we'd take a closer look--got ta see their leader given orders to some o' his men.
rows.quest:1783:details:1: BNarm an' me took the chance to kill a few of 'em, but they proved tougher than we thought, an' more of 'em got the jump on us. Narm tol' me to run an' get support, so 'ere I am.
rows.quest:1783:details:2: BNarm needs help, an' I'll not rest till he gets it.
rows.quest:1783:completion:1: BI can only assume that Tiza and Muiredon sent you here to aid me if you carry the Symbol of Life.
rows.quest:1783:completion:2: BIt's true, I fell to the Dark Iron while trying to attain one of the scripts: I was able to hold on long enough to allow Muiredon to escape, but the Light had almost embraced me fully when you came along. The fact that you were powerful enough to use the Symbol means great things for you, but there's time to speak of that later.
rows.quest:1784:obj:0: Retrieve a Dark Iron Script from the Dark Iron dwarves near Helm's Bed, and return to Muiredon Battleforge in ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:1784:details:0: Before I fell in battle, Muiredon and I had almost defeated one of the Dark Iron spies near that small house. We witnessed their captain passing orders to them, and sought to kill him and take the orders.
rows.quest:1784:details:1: BSome of the council in ⟦E3⟧ do not yet believe the presence of Dark Iron dwarves exists in ⟦E8⟧. By attaining one of those scripts, we'll not only have proof of their movements, but possibly an idea of what they're planning.
rows.quest:1784:details:2: BGet one of those scripts and take it back to Muiredon, ⟦35⟧.
rows.quest:1784:completion:0: Haha! You've done it! Ya saved Narm, and ya found the proof me wife needs to take to the council. Yer a blessin' o' the Light if I ever saw one... not includin' me wife o' course.
rows.quest:1785:details:0: I c'n see me wife's o'er there beamin' wit pride already. Ya better get yer tuchus o'er there pronto. I be thinkin' she'd have some words wit ya.
rows.quest:1785:details:1: BLight be witcha, mighty ⟦37⟧. I'll be lookin' fer ya on the battlefield against the Scourge and dem Dark Irons when the time comes.
rows.quest:1785:completion:0: You've done all of ⟦E3⟧ a great favor today, ⟦38⟧. I'm proud to count you among us, and if you feel you're ready, I would like to bless you with this scroll. The Symbol of Life would only have worked when used by a ⟦39⟧ who was ready for one of the Light's greatest blessings-the power to restore the dead back to life.
rows.quest:1785:completion:1: BI will teach you the ability to ⟦E7⟧ your companions. Use it wisely, ⟦40⟧, and thank you, on behalf of myself, my husband, and ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:1786:obj:0: Take the Symbol of Life and ⟦E7⟧ Henze Faulk in Elwynn.
rows.quest:1786:details:0: Henze and I had made it to Heroes' Vigil, an island in the middle of Stone Cairn Lake in northeastern Elwynn. We'd heard the Defias had infiltrated our borders and we wanted proof to take to the king's advisors.
rows.quest:1786:details:1: BWe caught sight of a couple of the scum going over some documents, and we attacked. Unfortunately, we were quickly overwhelmed by more of the mages.
rows.quest:1786:details:2: BHenze held them off for me while I escaped... the daft fool, going and being brave.
rows.quest:1786:details:3: BHe's out there now, Henze is. Can you help us, ⟦41⟧?
rows.quest:1786:completion:1: BSeeing you wield the Symbol of Life, may I assume Duthorian or Gazin sent you?
rows.quest:1786:completion:2: BI fell to the Defias spell casters while Gazin and I tried to get their plans from them: I was able to hold on long enough to allow Gazin to escape, but in the end, their magics overwhelmed me.
rows.quest:1786:completion:3: BBut you were able to bring me back: the ability to use the Symbol doesn't come to just anyone, ⟦43⟧. It bodes well for you that you were able to empower it with your own faith.
rows.quest:1787:obj:0: Retrieve a Defias Script from the Defias Rogue Wizards in Elwynn, and return to Gazin Tenorm in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:1787:details:0: We'll have time to talk more about the Symbol at a later time. What's important now is to get those papers we saw the Defias going over. If we can get our hands on them, we'll be able to prove the Defias have infiltrated Elwynn and hopefully gain some insight into what their plans are.
rows.quest:1787:details:1: BI'm in no shape for battle as of now, ⟦44⟧. Do you think you're strong enough to get those papers from the Defias here on the island?
rows.quest:1787:details:2: BIf you're able to get them, bring them back to Gazin and let him know I'm all right.
rows.quest:1787:completion:0: Wonderful! You made it, and saved Henze. The Light is with you for sure, ⟦45⟧!
rows.quest:1788:details:0: I'll take the script to the King's advisors after Duthorian's taken a look at them, but in the meantime, you should go speak to Duthorian now. He'll be wanting to pat you on the back for sure!
rows.quest:1788:details:1: BThank you again, ⟦46⟧. I hope we meet again. You're surely an ally I'm proud to call friend.
rows.quest:1788:completion:0: You've done well this day, ⟦47⟧. You should take some pride in what you've accomplished.
rows.quest:1788:completion:1: BEven more so, you should be proud of your abilities. Not everyone can use the power of the Symbol of Life. Calling upon the Light to bring back the dead means you're prepared for one of the ⟦48⟧'s greatest honors: the power of resurrection.
rows.quest:1788:completion:2: BYou shall have the power to bring back fallen companions much like you did for Henze.
rows.quest:1788:completion:3: BBe well, ⟦49⟧. The Light shines upon you and you should welcome it wholly.
rows.quest:1806:obj:0: Wait for Jordan Stilwell to finish forging a weapon for you.
rows.quest:1806:details:0: Why don't we go over to the forge and get started on this? I've been preparing for your arrival for some time, so it shouldn't take long at all.
rows.quest:1806:details:1: BWhen we're done, you'll be far more prepared to defend the Light than you have been, this much I swear.
rows.quest:1806:details:2: BI'll be somewhat honest, ⟦50⟧, seeing the results of your exploits makes me somewhat envious. But knowing that I can contribute to your adventures in my own significant way does bring me some joy.
rows.quest:1806:completion:0: Here it is, ⟦51⟧. A weapon worthy of a champion of the Light such as yourself. I've named it after a great dwarven paladin who was a friend of mine. His name was Verigan... Bosch Verigan.
rows.quest:1806:completion:1: BPlease take it on behalf of myself and my wife. We owe you a great debt, and the world will be a safer place with one of your skill traveling the land.
rows.quest:2997:details:0: Hello, ⟦52⟧. I know you're busy helping out the people of ⟦E8⟧, but when you have the time, you should make your way up to ⟦E3⟧ to speak to one of our most respected ilk: Tiza Battleforge. She's the one the younger paladins go to when it's time they learn more about the Light and what's expected of ya.
rows.quest:2997:details:1: BYou can find her upstairs in the Hall of Mysteries. If you've never been there, it's in the Mystic Ward. Good luck to ya, ⟦53⟧.
rows.quest:2997:completion:0: Well met, ⟦54⟧. I hope the Light shows you the true path and keeps you safe from evil.
rows.quest:2998:details:0: Greetings, ⟦55⟧. Duthorian Rall, one of our most influential paladins, was speaking about you recently. I overheard him talking about how it was time you be put to the test some... along with some very complimentary things about how well you've performed thus far.
rows.quest:2998:details:1: BIf I were you, I'd head to ⟦E1⟧ and speak to him when you have time. I'm sure he's in the Cathedral of Light--that's where he spends most of his time.
rows.quest:2998:completion:0: It is beautiful here in ⟦E1⟧, is it not?
rows.quest:2998:completion:1: BYour timing actually couldn't have been better, ⟦56⟧.
rows.quest:2999:details:0: Hello, ⟦57⟧. I know you're busy helping out the people of ⟦E8⟧, but when you have the time, you should go upstairs and speak to one of our most respected ilk: Tiza Battleforge. She's the one the younger paladins go to when it's time they learn more about the Light and what's expected of ya.
rows.quest:2999:completion:0: Well met, ⟦58⟧. I hope the Light shows you the true path and keeps you safe from evil.
rows.quest:3000:details:0: Hello, ⟦59⟧. I know you're busy helping out the people of ⟦E2⟧, but when you have the time, you should return to ⟦E3⟧ and speak to one of the most respected paladins of your home: Tiza Battleforge. She's the one the younger dwarven paladins go to when it is time they learn more about the Light and what's expected of all of us.
rows.quest:3000:details:1: BYou can find her upstairs in the Hall of Mysteries which is located in the Mystic Ward.
rows.quest:3000:completion:0: I greet you, and bid you welcome, ⟦60⟧.
rows.quest:3101:obj:0: Read the Consecrated Letter and speak to Brother Sammuel in ⟦E9⟧ Abbey.
rows.quest:3101:details:0: I was asked to bring this to your attention as soon as you returned from the kobold camps, ⟦61⟧. It appears to be a letter sealed with the insignia of Brother Sammuel, our local paladin trainer. I wouldn't hesitate to read it before you go about any other business here in the Abbey.
rows.quest:3101:completion:0: In the meantime, you should know one or two other things. You are a symbol to many here in this land--act accordingly. The ⟦E10⟧ shines within you, and it will be obvious to both your allies and your enemies.
rows.quest:3101:completion:1: BAlso, as you gain in wisdom and power, you will need to train to learn new abilities. That's where I come in. When you feel you've gained some experience here in ⟦E9⟧, come back to me and I will teach you what I feel you are ready to learn. Good luck... ⟦62⟧!
rows.quest:3107:obj:0: Read the Consecrated Rune and speak to Bromos Grummner in Coldridge Valley.
rows.quest:3107:details:0: While you were helping me out, this rune was given to me to pass on to you. Take some time to read it when you have a chance. I'm thinkin' it came from the paladin trainer Bromos. Take a gander at it and go find him inside Anvilmar when you've a chance.
rows.quest:3107:completion:0: The humans have taught us a great deal about the ⟦E10⟧ and how important their order is to them... and to protecting all of ⟦E2⟧. We have a great respect for how stepped in tradition it is, and how just one figure, one sacrifice, can make the difference between pain and ⟦E11⟧.
rows.quest:3107:completion:1: BThe two of us are gonna be working together for a bit. Any time you think you're ready, come back to me and we'll see about getting you some training. Can't have you go out into the world unprepared, now, can we?
rows.quest:3681:details:0: Sorry to interrupt your travels, ⟦63⟧, but I thought you should know that word was sent from ⟦E1⟧ recently asking that paladins report there for training.
rows.quest:3681:details:1: BIf I didn't know any better, I'd say your close to reaching a special time and it's time you started studying the Tomes.
rows.quest:3681:details:2: BLook for Duthorian Rall in ⟦E1⟧. He usually trains paladins in the Cathedral of Light.
rows.quest:3681:completion:0: Welcome to the Cathedral of Light, ⟦64⟧.
rows.quest:4485:details:0: Hello, ⟦65⟧. I see your dedication remains strong, as does your faith.
rows.quest:4485:details:1: BI think it is time you spoke with Duthorian Rall in ⟦E1⟧. There are some more lessons for you to learn, and I feel you are prepared.
rows.quest:4485:details:2: BSeek him out in the Cathedral of Light, and ⟦66⟧, take these lessons seriously. You've attained your status through humility and hard work, do not disappoint us by becoming arrogant.
rows.quest:4486:details:0: Well, well, well, look at the mighty paladin in all ⟦67⟧ regality.
rows.quest:4486:details:1: BSorry, ⟦68⟧, I meant no offense... I just get a little jealous sometimes when I see some of the feats you've accomplished. Tiza tells me it's my weakness, and I swore to her I'd work on it. It's just hard sometimes, you know?
rows.quest:4486:details:2: BBut the reason I wanted to talk to you was because Duthorian Rall in ⟦E1⟧ sent word for you to meet him in the Cathedral of Light when you're ready. Sounded important. Sounded like something's going on.
rows.quest:7637:obj:0: ⟦E12⟧ to ⟦E3⟧ and get High Priest Rohan's ⟦E13⟧ Censer. You will need to make a donation of 150 gold in order to secure it.
rows.quest:7637:details:0: In order to prepare yourself for this task, you must first show due sacrifice and judgment... with an emphasis on sacrifice.
rows.quest:7637:details:1: BYou must acquire High Priest Rohan's exorcism censer for your task. Even though its use will be for good and just reasons, due compensation must be given for it.
rows.quest:7637:details:2: BProceed to ⟦E3⟧ and speak with the High Priest. By bringing ample coin with you to help offset the loss of his censer, it will show your due sacrifice.
rows.quest:7637:details:3: BGo now ⟦69⟧, time is of the essence.
rows.quest:7637:completion:0: Blessings onto you, friend ⟦70⟧! Your donation goes far beyond what was needed. Your sacrifice will not only help us recover what we have lost, but also help us to help those most in need here in ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:7637:completion:1: BNow, let me make sure I've suitably prepared this censer for your future needs...
rows.quest:7638:obj:0: Speak with Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in ⟦E1⟧'s Cathedral District.
rows.quest:7638:details:0: The time has come, ⟦71⟧, for you to learn about what it will take for you to acquire something you have no doubt waited on for some time... your charger.
rows.quest:7638:details:1: BSpeak with Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker here in ⟦E1⟧'s Cathedral District. It is he who will guide you not only though the legerdemain of a Paladin's most trusted mount, but the tasks before you to acquire one of your own.
rows.quest:7638:details:2: BI wish you the best in this trial. For the Light, noble ⟦72⟧!
rows.quest:7638:completion:0: I am glad to see you ⟦73⟧. I know that you have awaited word as to how to acquire your charger, and now that time has come.
rows.quest:7638:completion:1: BYou will be surely tested in many different ways, but most importantly in your willingness to rise above numerous obstacles thrust before you. These are not done as a learning exercise - your stature is beyond simple educational tests. You must save your future companion from the clutches of the evil you have spent your life fighting.
rows.quest:7638:completion:2: BTake heed, your time has come!
rows.quest:7639:obj:0: Return the ⟦E13⟧ Censer to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in the Cathedral District of ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:7639:details:0: With my blessings, take the censer. I myself have used it in several exorcisms, and it should serve you well for the arduous tasks that lie ahead.
rows.quest:7639:details:1: BReturn now to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in ⟦E1⟧, ⟦74⟧. Your quest continues with him.
rows.quest:7639:completion:0: Yes, this will do. You will be called upon more than once during this process to make acts of sacrifice; I am glad to see that you are willing to do just that. ⟦E14⟧ is a key component in what it takes to uphold the duties of being a Paladin... but I don't have to lecture you on that.
rows.quest:7639:completion:1: BNow ⟦75⟧, you will need to show due judgment in your actions. To that end, this censer will act as your vessel to dispense such judgment on tortured spirits of lands lost to us.
rows.quest:7640:obj:0: Use the ⟦E13⟧ Censer to drive out the spirits that torment Terrordale. When you have slain 25 Terrordale Spirits, return to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in the Cathedral District of ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:7640:details:0: I have added a pinch of dirt from the tainted ground of Terrordale in the ⟦E15⟧ to the censer. You will now use this censer to find areas there that show signs of spiritual turmoil and disturbance. Look for green auras that permeate the ground as the physical world buckles under the torment of the spirit realm and use the censer to drive out the evil spirits.
rows.quest:7640:details:1: BWhen you have passed sufficient judgment on the spirits there, you will be ready to proceed.
rows.quest:7640:completion:0: Well done, ⟦76⟧. To render the judgment of the Light on those that dwell in darkness is a task we must approach with vim and zeal; you have done just that with your sacrifice in ⟦E3⟧ and your judgments of the spirits in Terrordale.
rows.quest:7640:completion:1: BYour next steps will call on both sacrifice and judgment again as you now strive to reclaim the spirit of a fallen charger who now serves a Death Knight known as Darkreaver.
rows.quest:7641:obj:0: Speak with Grimand Elmore in ⟦E1⟧'s Dwarven District.
rows.quest:7641:details:0: A paladin's charger is nothing more than a pack animal without proper barding for it. The barding used by your charger not only needs to be of the finest materials possible, but because of the circumstances involved it must also be sufficiently attuned to the spirit realm.
rows.quest:7641:details:1: BFirst things first, ⟦77⟧ - let's get your barding made. In ⟦E1⟧'s Dwarven District is one of the finest craftsmen living today, Grimand Elmore. His work will not be cheap, but his quality is what we seek. Speak with him.
rows.quest:7641:completion:0: Hello there - Lord Shadowbreaker sent me word ahead of time that you'd be coming around this way to see me. I'm willing to make the barding you need, but it won't be either cheap or easy; let's get that out in the open first and foremost.
rows.quest:7641:completion:1: BI will say this much, and Grayson will back me up when I make this claim... you'll not find better barding made anywhere in all of ⟦E2⟧ than right here.
rows.quest:7642:obj:0: Bring 40 Runecloth, 6 Arcanite Bars, 10 ⟦E16⟧' Tears, 5 ⟦E17⟧ Holy Water vials, and 150 gold to Grimand Elmore in the Dwarven District of ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:7642:details:0: You'll need four things for the barding - runecloth for the lining, arcanite bars for the plating, ⟦E16⟧' Tears for the spiritual attunement, and ⟦E17⟧ holy water for the spiritual imbuement. Actually, you need five things... gold for my fee. That fee includes all labor as well as a handcrafted saddle and stirrups.
rows.quest:7642:details:1: BOnce you've got all that, I'll be able to finish your barding. Until then, there are some things I can get started on for you while you assemble your collection of goods.
rows.quest:7642:completion:0: This... well, this is exactly what I needed. You're quite the resourceful ⟦78⟧, aren't you?
rows.quest:7642:completion:1: BAll right then, let's get this barding finished up for you!
rows.quest:7643:obj:0: Acquire special horse feed used for feeding a spirit horse. Merideth Carlson in ⟦E18⟧ apparently is the source for such food.
rows.quest:7643:obj:1: BTravel to the Dire ⟦E19⟧ dungeon in ⟦E20⟧ and slay Tendris Warpwood. Doing so will free the Ancient Equine Spirit. Feed it the special horse feed, thereby soothing the spirit. Finally, give it the Arcanite Barding so it may bless it.
rows.quest:7643:details:0: Your barding needs a special form of blessing, one from an appropriate spirit. In Dire ⟦E19⟧ is such a spirit, the Ancient Equine Spirit. It is currently held by a corrupt ⟦E21⟧, Tendris Warpwood. Pass judgment upon this foul beast, ⟦79⟧.
rows.quest:7643:details:1: BKnow this - freedom alone is not enough. You must soothe the spirit before receiving its blessing. For that, special horse feed is needed. ⟦E12⟧ to ⟦E18⟧ first and speak with Merideth Carlson on this... and prepare for more sacrifice.
rows.quest:7643:completion:0: The Ancient Equine Spirit accepts the offering of the Manna-Enriched Horse Feed, nuzzling the container as it helps itself to the special oats and grains. After it has eaten a little, it looks at the barding you possess and positions itself as though it wants you to place it upon its back...
